name: What are the benefits of choosing a walk-in shower over a traditional tub/shower combo?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing a walk-in shower over a traditional tub/shower combo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in showers offer enhanced accessibility, making them ideal for aging in place or for individuals with mobility concerns, as they eliminate the high threshold of a tub. They also provide a more spacious and open feel to a bathroom, contributing to a modern aesthetic. Maintenance can be simpler without a shower curtain or framed door, and they often offer greater design flexibility for a personalized look. In some cases, they can increase home value and appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walk-in showers improve accessibility, offer a spacious modern aesthetic, can be easier to maintain, and provide design flexibility.
